stage_name_zh: 阶段 4：顶会论文、具身智能/生成建模、学术演讲与全周期综合复习（Day 76–116）
learning_objectives_zh: 通过 8 个核心词群（涵盖今日 28 个目标词条）掌握熟悉词汇的学术熟词生义（Polysemy）、一词多义边界、可数/及物性变化与自然搭配。
掌握句子成分精细分析（主、谓、宾、表、定、状、同位语）与核心语法：【G022】并列、从属、平行结构（Parallelism）与对比对称性；【G027】文献综述、观点归属与报道动词（Reporting Verbs）的认知立场控制。
掌握学术表达模式：【EP022】消融实验（Ablation Study）与基线公平对比（Fair Baseline Comparison），彻底消除头重脚轻、口语化、过度表达与空洞 AI 套话。
完成 36 道高密度、单点聚焦的实战练习，确保今日每个词条均获得至少 3 次训练（含至少 2 次主动输出）。

grammar_instruction.name: 并列、从属、平行结构（Parallelism）与对比对称性
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 由 and, or, rather than, as opposed to, as well as, both... and... 连接的成分必须在词性、句法层级与逻辑角色上严格平行。
rules: 对比排除连接词（rather than, as opposed to）两侧结构必须平行：reporting observed values as opposed to predictions；measured an association rather than a causal effect。
分别对应结构（A and B ... X and Y, respectively）两侧元素个数与顺序必须严格一一对应。
examples: The table reports observed values as opposed to predictions.
The symbols x and y denote temperature and demand, respectively.
common_errors: 两侧词性不对称：*combines quantitative measurements with interviewing participants（名词短语与动名词不对称）。

grammar_instruction.name: 文献综述、观点归属与报道动词（Reporting Verbs）的认知立场控制
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 在 Related Work 与议论文引用中，通过精准选择报道动词（argue, claim, assert, contend, maintain, suggest, note, observe, point out, demonstrate, show, acknowledge, question, challenge）体现对前人工作的客观定位。
rules: 区分事实呈现（show, demonstrate, reveal）、作者主观论断（claim, assert, contend, maintain）与审慎提议（suggest, propose, hypothesize）。
According to the authors 仅用于引述他人或外部记录，绝不可写 *According to me。
examples: The authors argue that simpler baselines deserve attention.
The author asserts that the categories are exhaustive, whereas recent benchmarks challenge this assumption.
common_errors: 用一成不变的 *Author A says that... 贯穿整个 Related Work 章节。

grammar_instruction.name: 去除“AI 味（Anti-AI-ese）”与过度修辞：用具体机制、指标与实例替代空洞夸张
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 典型 AI 生成文本充斥着空洞的套话与浮夸副词/形容词（如 delve into, testament to, tapestry, underscores the paramount importance, revolutionize, unparalleled, groundbreaking），却缺乏具体技术细节。地道顶会论文（NeurIPS/ICLR/CoRL）与高分雅思/托福/六级写作追求“低修辞密度、高信息密度”：用具体动词、明确指标和真实实例说话。
rules: 删除无实质信息的“清嗓子”套话（Throat-clearing）：少用 *It is worth noting that / It is undeniable that / In the realm of modern artificial intelligence*，直接陈述事实主干。

禁止“只有夸张形容词而不给实例或数据支撑”：不要写 *The model achieves an enormous, unparalleled improvement*，而要写 *The proposed parametrization reduces MSE by 8.4% relative to the seasonal naive baseline on hourly electricity demand*。
优先选用朴素、精准的单音节或核心学术动词（examine, test, compare, constrain, decompose, bound, mitigate）替代故作高深的修辞词。
examples:
AI 腔/空洞夸张：*This groundbreaking paradigm delves into the intricate tapestry of temporal dynamics and achieves unparalleled accuracy.*
地道学术改写：*This model decomposes the series into trend and seasonal components, achieving lower forecasting error than the linear baseline on three benchmarks.*

六级/雅思空洞句：*Technology has an enormous impact on education in many ways.*
地道具体展开：*Asynchronous learning platforms allow part-time students to review lecture recordings at their own pace, reducing scheduling conflicts.*
common_errors: 堆砌 paramount, unprecedented, revolutionize, multifaceted 等宣传式词汇，违反客观学术语域。
只下宏大判断（如 *This method is very efficient*）而不给出具体的计算复杂度、内存占用或延迟数据。

expression_pattern_instruction.name: 消融实验（Ablation Study）与基线公平对比（Fair Baseline Comparison）
expression_pattern_instruction.template: To disentangle the contribution of [Component A] from [Component B], we compare the full model against a conventional baseline under comparable conditions.
expression_pattern_instruction.explanation_zh: 用于实验与消融分析章节，严谨剥离各模块的独立贡献，避免只挑有利指标汇报（selective reporting）。
examples: Every proposed method should be compared against a relevant baseline under comparable conditions.
The study design aims to disentangle the effect of training from prior experience.
common_errors: 使用 unparallelled / groundbreaking 等空洞吹嘘词代替具体的消融实验差值与误差棒说明。

expression_pattern_instruction.name: 明确陈述研究目标、问题定义与讨论边界
expression_pattern_instruction.template: This study/paper examines [specific problem] and aims to [verb] [measurable objective] within [stated scope].
expression_pattern_instruction.explanation_zh: 开门见山说明研究问题与范围，主语简短，直接用强动词 examines / addresses / investigates。
examples: This paper addresses unequal access to educational resources.
The aim of this paper is to compare annotation rules.
common_errors: 使用冗长空洞的套话开头，或写 *address to a problem。
